title: Lighter Butter Chicken with Spinach & Basmati
description: A warming yogurt-marinated chicken curry with just 15 g of butter, a splash of cooking cream and a big handful of spinach, over basmati. Garlic-free — ginger does the work.

steps.title: Marinate, 20 min
steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, the paprika, turmeric and ½ tsp salt. Leave 20 min (or up to a day in the fridge).

steps.title: Cook the rice, 12 min + 10 min rest
steps.text: Rinse the basmati until the water runs clear. Bring to the boil with the 225 ml water and a pinch of salt, then cover and simmer on the lowest heat 12 min. Take off the heat and leave covered 10 min.

steps.title: Sear the chicken, 5–6 min
steps.text: Melt 5 g butter in a large non-stick pan over high heat. Sear the chicken with its marinade 5–6 min until coloured but not cooked through, then tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Build the sauce, 8 + 10 min
steps.text: Lower to medium, add the remaining 10 g butter and the onion and soften 8 min. Add the ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, the cumin, chilli and tomato paste and cook 1 min. Pour in the passata and the remaining ½ tsp salt and simmer 10 min.

steps.title: Finish, 8–10 min
steps.text: Stir in the cooking cream, return the chicken and simmer gently 8–10 min until cooked through. Fold in the spinach and let it wilt 2 min. Crumble in the fenugreek leaves if using.

steps.title: Plate
steps.text: Matthias: about two-thirds of the curry (around 370 g raw chicken) and 300 g cooked rice (⅔ of the pot). Nyuszika: the remaining third (around 180 g chicken) and 150 g cooked rice.

notes: No protein bridge needed. Garlic-free. Frozen leaf spinach works if baby spinach is out on Kifli.
